newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street expected higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street expected higher at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open higher on Friday after the release of the Producer Pice Index for June which showed scant evidence of inflation.
The PPI, which was forecast unchanged, fell 0.1 percent, while the core PPI rose 0.1 percent.
Analysts said the absence of inflationary signs will damp down, for the time being, fears of higher interest rates.
The Dow Jones index closed on Thursday at 7886.76, up 44.33 points.
